metadata.title: Quasi-contact metric structures from Sasaki-Einstein metrics
metadata.abstract: We construct the first examples of quasi-contact metric structures that are not contact metric in every odd dimension greater than or equal to $5$. In dimension $5$, we construct a one-parameter family of such examples with a Killing characteristic vector field by deforming Sasaki-Einstein $\mathrm{SU}(2)$-structures. This yields compact, homogeneous examples on $S^5$. In arbitrary dimensions, we investigate quasi-contact metric structures with a Killing characteristic vector field and derive a Ricci curvature criterion for the structure to be K-contact.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 非接触的 quasi-contact 度量结构
analysis.workSummary: 通过 Sasaki–Einstein SU(2) 结构变形，在每个奇维≥5 构造不是 contact metric 的 quasi-contact 例子；五维得到 Killing 特征场的一参数紧齐性 S⁵ 族，并给 Ricci 判据。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出区分 quasi-contact 与 contact metric 的首批高维例子。
analysis.limitations: Killing 特征场不自动意味着 K-contact；需文中额外 Ricci 条件。
